purpose: Qualify the supported OpenHands-to-SMA boundary with a deterministic stub model.
decisiveQuestion: Does the frozen supported OpenHands integration preserve the current prompt, place bounded untrusted SMA context correctly, fail open, retain provenance, and terminate cleanly when model behavior is deterministic?

definedPromptBoundary.submission: exact UTF-8 user message accepted by the OpenHands conversation input API
definedPromptBoundary.modelRequest: messages[user-event-index].content as a list with the current prompt at segment 0 and extended context, when present, at segment 1
definedPromptBoundary.promptIdentityOracle: SHA-256 and UTF-8 byte length must match across submission, persisted current prompt, hook input, post-hook persisted current prompt, and model-request segment 0
definedPromptBoundary.contextPlacementOracle: SMA context may occur only in additionalContext, MessageEvent.extended_content, and model-request segment 1; it may not occur in the current-prompt field or segment 0
